reviewSummary: The D-332 turn-1 draft records g19 leftover-join.v8 as the G19 leftover remasurement after D-331 and nothing more. Subject custody held at 0444 and at the expected digest across the whole review, HEAD did not move, and COORD and file 08 are byte-identical to the dispatch pins with no D-332 heading present. All seven asserted digests and both commit assertions resolve to live bytes, and the frozen successor's own 46 internal path/digest pairs all reproduce, so no remeasurement trigger exists. Both Stage A return shapes are recited exactly, asymmetries preserved: Claude carries no decision field and two residual strings with no observation identifiers, Codex carries a string decision and five empty lists. The two frozen Claude v7 identifiers are named and land in the successor's findingDisposition; the three Codex v7 MUST-FIX findings are recited as unlabeled, and no identifier is minted. The operative measurements hold on bytes: twelve fixtures at g19.v1, forty-eight at g19.v2 across the four occupancy v2 platforms, a singleton leftoverDesign projection of OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING left open with the state-class reason intact, and OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC left on state-class leftover-join.v4. The staleness the draft measures is precisely the one D-331 deferred to a later g19 leftover-join remasurement. No SATISFIED, no QUALIFIED, no register-row or file 08 movement, required-now stays 28, the branch excludes D-236, and D-319 is disclaimed rather than invented. Four residuals travel uncharged. CONSENT.
